supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced extension beyond the lateral canthus of the eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle and sub-nasal areas exhibit significantly lighter pixel intensity compared to the dark periocular and frontal regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: low vertical thickness with a neutral horizontal resting profile

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast light-colored patch or highlight on the lateral portion of the supraorbital ridge
